bear_case: Counter-argument: the HOLD upgrade rests on five conditions, all triggered in a single session (June 4) and one trading day old — each reversible within hours of a single data release. A hot NFP above 165K would void the 30Y sub-5.0% Day-2 sequence before the ink is dry, an outcome consistent with the underlying labor data stack (JOLTS 7.6M, ADP 122K, ISM Services Prices 71.3% — the highest reading since August 2022). The Iran ceasefire MOU carries the same structural fragility as every prior ceasefire moment since May; Iranian ballistic missiles struck Kuwait Thursday and Trump has not signed the 60-day extension. AVGO's two-session 15% AI revenue guidance-plateau repricing is the first systematic de-rating of AI infrastructure multiples in this cycle; if that template spreads to NVDA's late-July earnings, the framework's primary risk-on position becomes a liability timed directly into the SPCX $75B capital-drain event. Invalidation: if NFP prints above 165K AND the 30Y closes above 5.00% Friday, revert HOLD to STEP ASIDE immediately — close XLF, pause NVDA add, tighten NVDA stop to $218.
